newsitem.title: UK: Dairy Crest starts at 38p premium to offer.
newsitem.headline: Dairy Crest starts at 38p premium to offer.

text.p: Shares in Dairy Crest began trading on Wednesday at a 17 percent premium to the flotation price in heavy trade.
The shares, which were offered to eligble milk producers at 155p each, started trading at 182p, later rising to 193p.
Almost 88 percent of the eligible producers had opted for shares rather than cash as part of the flotation of the former Milk Marketing Board processing arm.
The company's original flotation value was pared back from 200 million stg to 171 million stg amid fears that the new issues market was becoming overloaded.
Around 2.5 million Dairy Crest shares changed hands in the first 1-1/2 hours of dealings.
